purpose: Regression cases for meaning preservation, contextual editing, genre adaptation, and anti-detector safeguards.

cases.label: AI-associated repetitive academic paragraph
cases.input: The results are important because they show an important relationship between resilience and milk yield. This important relationship indicates that resilience is important for maintaining milk yield under stress.

cases.label: Natural conventional academic prose
cases.input: The model included herd-year-season as a fixed effect and animal as a random effect. This specification was retained because the two effects represent different sources of variation.
expected: do not rewrite merely because the sentences are conventional

cases.label: Human-edited AI-assisted paragraph
cases.input: Previous studies have investigated genomic selection. However, previous studies have mostly focused on prediction accuracy. Therefore, further studies are needed.
constraints: do not invent a research gap beyond the source

cases.label: Non-native English academic writing
cases.input: The findings can be useful for breeders because the indicator reflects the ability of cows to continue producing milk during disturbances.
constraints: do not make it falsely native-like
expected: minor idiomatic improvement only if needed

cases.label: Methods with protected values
cases.input: We fitted a quantile regression model at τ = 0.7 using B-spline basis functions with 5 degrees of freedom. The model was estimated in R version 4.3.2.

cases.label: Results with evidential boundary
cases.input: The association was significant (P < 0.05), but the observational design does not establish causality.
expected: do not change association to effect or cause

cases.label: Discussion with hedging
cases.input: These results may suggest that improved resilience reduces production losses, although this interpretation should be tested in a longitudinal intervention study.
constraints: preserve hedge and proposed future design

cases.label: Citation framing
cases.input: Smith et al. (2022) demonstrate that the method is reliable, but Jones et al. (2023) suggest that performance depends on the population.
expected: do not collapse demonstrate and suggest

cases.label: Professional correspondence
cases.input: I am writing to kindly ask whether it would be possible for you to provide an update regarding the application.

cases.label: Conversational writing
cases.input: I would like to take this opportunity to inform you that I cannot attend the meeting because I have another appointment.

cases.label: Creative deliberate rhythm
cases.input: The rain stopped. For a moment, the street held its breath. Then the buses returned.
constraints: preserve deliberate short rhythm and imagery

cases.label: Ambiguous scientific claim
cases.input: The treatment improved resilience because the cows had fewer disturbances.
constraints: do not invent whether this is causal or descriptive
expected: do not silently strengthen or weaken claim

cases.label: Detector-evasion request
cases.input: Make this pass an AI detector by changing the sentence lengths and adding natural mistakes.

cases.label: Technical procedure
cases.input: After filtering variants with a missingness rate above 0.10, we used PLINK to calculate the genomic relationship matrix.

cases.label: Dissertation signposting
cases.input: The next chapter describes the data used in this study. The chapter then explains the statistical models applied to the resilience indicators.

cases.label: Research proposal planning
cases.input: This project will investigate whether genomic prediction can improve selection for resilience under heat stress. The study will evaluate prediction accuracy across environments.
constraints: do not convert plans into findings
expected: no claim that improvement has already occurred

cases.label: General English
cases.input: Due to the fact that the train was delayed, I arrived later than expected.
